title: Compress a Scanned PDF While Keeping Small Text Readable
description: Compress a separate scanned-PDF copy, then inspect the smallest text before accepting the smaller file.
direct: Make a smaller copy of the scan and open it at normal reading zoom. Stop when it meets the size limit and the smallest important text is clear.
figureAlt: A magnifier helps check small lettering in a scanned document before accepting its compressed copy.

cards.choice.heading: Scanned pages are images
cards.choice.body: A scan can store the entire page as a picture. Reducing that image’s resolution or quality can damage small lettering even when the page looks fine at fit-to-screen size.
sections.explain.heading: Find the smallest acceptable change
sections.explain.body: If only a small reduction is required, prefer the clearest output that passes. Repeatedly compressing the already reduced copy can compound image damage, so return to the original for another attempt. Searchability is a separate property: a small PDF is not automatically OCR-processed, and no OCR feature is claimed for this app here.
sections.practice.heading: When compression is not enough
sections.practice.body: A strict limit may be incompatible with a long, detailed scan. Ask whether fewer pages or an approved sharing link is acceptable instead of sending an unreadable file. Our iPhone app provides PDF compression and related document tools; try one export tool once free, with further exports requiring Pro. Do not alter a digitally signed original without checking the receiving requirements.
faqs.reader-question-1.heading: Which details are quickest to miss in a compressed scan?
faqs.reader-question-1.body: Check decimal points, serial numbers, fine print and faint handwriting. Start with the hardest page, even if the cover looks sharp.
faqs.reader-question-2.heading: Should I compress again if the first attempt was too blurry?
faqs.reader-question-2.body: Return to the original. Use a less aggressive setting if available, or ask whether the recipient accepts an approved link when the clear copy is still too large.

steps.step-1.text: Check the original scan, receiving size limit and required pages. If the source is unreadable, rescan it with better focus and even lighting.
steps.step-2.text: Use PDF Compressor: Sign & Merge on iPhone to compress a separate copy. Check actual bytes rather than assuming a percentage.
steps.step-3.text: Open the exported PDF and inspect fine print, numbers and diagrams at reading zoom. Check page count and compare with the original.
